messages:
zara: quick heads-up 10:00 PT launch posts pushed. GA shows 1.6k sessions to /launch-but we only have 37 MQLs in the KPI export. can someone sanity-check attribution before monday? :eyes:

mike: saw the bump. flagging two things to check: (1) inbound routing uses utm_medium mapping to 'social' or 'referral' and (2) webinar signup form may drop utm on POST if referer absent.

tess: i reused the campaign template and set utm_medium=post_social. is that recognised by routing? we usually whitelist 'social' and 'paid'.

analytics-bot: quick snapshot: sessions=1598, page_views=1540, form_submits=62, pulse_mqls_export=37. top_referrers: t.co(39%), short.link(20%), linkedin(18%). last_sync=4923456060.

olga: looks like 'post_social' is not in the mapping, so form logic defaults to channel='direct' and those leads get filtered out of the KPI export which only includes known channels.

tess: argh. i'll push a small template change to utm_medium=social now. PR: github.com/redwood/marketing/campaign-templates/pull/214

mike: can analytics reprocess leads for path '/launch-2026' and remap utm_medium 'post_social' -> 'social' for the last 8 hours? need numbers for monday.

analytics-bot: queued reprocess job. preview SQL: SELECT count(1) as recovered, utm_medium FROM inbound_leads_raw WHERE path='/launch-2026' AND utm_medium='post_social' AND created_at >= '2026-03-25' GROUP BY utm_medium; ETA ~6m.

olga: after reprocess please add an attribution_note on recovered rows: "utm_mapping_added_post_social" so the KPI export shows the backfill reason.

analytics-bot: reprocess complete. delta: +48 leads remapped to utm_medium='social' and campaign='spring_launch'. pulseboard backfilled at 4923456117.

zara: thanks. can someone add a one-line footnote for Monday KPI slides: "48 leads reattributed after utm_medium normalization (post_social -> social); dashboard updated"

tess: adding note to pulseboard and will add preflight checklist item to validate utm_medium values in templates.

mike: follow-ups: (1) add preflight UTMs check (tess), (2) add attribution_note column to KPI export (olga), (3) avoid using opaque shortlinks for final targets (zara). closing thread. :white_check_mark:
